The Story

A good host reads the room first

Off stage, he's Vinay Batra. On it, he's The Modish Monk — a name that pairs a sharp eye for style with a monk's calm under pressure. He briefs with the organiser, learns who is in the room, and keeps the programme moving without ever rushing anyone.

Online, he shares that same mix of calm and colour with his followers, and works with brands that fit that voice.

  • 01

Frequently asked

How far in advance should we book?

As early as possible once your date is fixed — popular weekends and festival dates fill up fastest.

Does he host in multiple languages?

Add the real answer here — which languages he hosts in and any regional preferences.

Can he travel outside the city?

Add the real answer here — travel radius, and whether travel and stay are billed separately.

What's included in a media kit?

Follower count and audience breakdown, past brand partners, sample rates, and full contact details.
